title: MS-Net: Multi-Site Network for Improving Prostate Segmentation With Heterogeneous MRI Data
mechanism: Train one segmentation network on several heterogeneous sites with shared conv kernels, site-specific batch normalisation and site-specific auxiliary branches plus multi-site knowledge transfer.
adaptation: Treat the 5 EL sources (ARTS, CFVS, CSIR, BMRK, SDLE) as sites in the house U-Net++: per-source BN (PyTorch re-implementation of the BN part only), source id known for every cell; E1 (101 CSIR + 5 BMRK) uses the CSIR / BMRK branches. Optional 6th site UCF-EL for joint (not sequential) training.
min_experiment: Arm: PF with per-source BN; baseline: PF. Module-grouped 5-fold CV, 2 seeds. Metrics: crack relF1@2, inactive IoU, BMRK crack IoU, then E1 crack recall. Kill if relF1@2 and inactive IoU both < +0.01 and BMRK crack IoU < +0.02.
evidence: R: consistent gains across 3 heterogeneous prostate MRI sites over joint training and single-site baselines (numbers not read).
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF per-panel BN adaptation was test-time BN; the SSL 'separate BN' split labelled vs unlabelled batches. Training-time per-source BN and joint multi-dataset training are listed as never tried.
